name: Aminorex
summary: Is an anorectic stimulant drug that was taken off the market after it was found to cause pulmonary hypertension. Potency wise it has been found to be roughly 2.5 times more potent than dextroamphetamine.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: Aminorex is a serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent (SNDRA). Its EC50 values for induction of monoamine release are 26.4 nM for norepinephrine, 49.4 nM for dopamine, and 193 nM for serotonin. In addition to its monoamine-releasing activity, aminorex is a weak agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2 receptors, including of the serotonin 5-HT2A, 5-HT2B, and 5-HT2C receptors.
pharmacology.kind: Stimulant; Appetite suppressant; Norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent

uses.text: Aminorex was formerly used as an appetite suppressant.

summaryZh: 阿米雷司（英語：Aminorex），也叫氨苯噁唑啉，是一種減肥（厭食）興奮劑藥物。在被發現會引起肺動脈高壓後，它被撤市了。在美國，它是一種非法的附表I藥物，這意味著它有很高的濫用可能性，沒有被接受的醫療用途，而且安全性很差。

sideEffects.en: It caused pulmonary hypertension, a raised pressure in the lung arteries that can be fatal, which is why it was withdrawn. As a stimulant it also causes sleeplessness, a fast heartbeat, raised blood pressure and anxiety.
sideEffects.zh: 它會造成肺動脈高壓，也就是肺部動脈壓力升高，可能致命，因此遭下市。作為興奮劑，它也會造成失眠、心跳加快、血壓升高與焦慮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它会造成肺动脉高压，也就是肺部动脉压力升高，可能致命，因此遭下市。作为兴奋剂，它也会造成失眠、心跳加快、血压升高与焦虑。

fact.en: In the late 1960s, when aminorex was sold as a slimming pill in Switzerland, Austria and Germany, doctors saw a sudden wave of pulmonary hypertension. It was one of the first clear cases of a diet drug damaging the lungs.
fact.zh: 1960 年代末，阿米雷司在瑞士、奧地利與德國作為減肥藥販售時，醫師發現肺動脈高壓病例突然激增。這是減肥藥傷害肺部最早被確認的案例之一。
fact.zhHans: 1960 年代末，阿米雷司在瑞士、奥地利与德国作为减肥药贩售时，医师发现肺动脉高压病例突然激增。这是减肥药伤害肺部最早被确认的案例之一。
